'''Sunfleur''' is a [[Grass]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Buddi]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Solaflora]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Sunfleur doesn't grow two heads after evolving'''―'''that'd be weird! Just climb out the pot and dance. Sun's up, and your Tatari friends need you!"

Sunfleur is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Three sunflowers on one stem, the center one the largest and with a creamy-white central disk and a happy facial expression. The smaller sunflowers on either side of the center one resemble arms and have brown central disks. It also has two leaves that function as legs.

Sunfleur's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its yellow petals with cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Sunfleur's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 silver stars/49 copies. To evolve it into [[Solaflora]] you need to complete the following two tasks:
* Feed Sunfleur to increase stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Buddi doesn't grow 2 heads when it evolves-that'd be weird! Just climb out of the pot and dance!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Free from the pot, Sunfleur wields blossom-like arms, twirling like a cheerleader who can always brighten the mood."
